# Cognolynx

> High-performance custom software engineering, modern digital products, and intelligent technology solutions.

Cognolynx is a modern software and product engineering company founded by Devakumar A. We design, architect, and build custom web applications, enterprise software systems, cross-platform mobile experiences, and AI-enabled workflows for forward-thinking businesses.

## Company Information
- Website: https://cognolynx.tech
- Founded & Led by: Devakumar A, Founder & Chief Executive Officer
- Contact Email: cognolynxforge@gmail.com
- Mode: Remote-first engineering studio (originating in Puducherry, India)

## Core Service Capabilities
1. Custom Software Engineering: Tailored business applications, automated enterprise workflows, backend database architectures, and secure REST/GraphQL APIs.
2. Web & Digital Platforms: Modern frontend architectures using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, engineered for speed, conversion, and global scale.
3. Mobile Product Engineering: High-performance cross-platform iOS and Android applications developed using Flutter and React Native.
4. AI & Intelligent Systems: Applied machine learning, automated decision engines, computer vision pipelines, and intelligent operational agents.
5. UI/UX Design Systems: Cohesive design tokens, component libraries, and ergonomic user journeys.
6. Growth & Performance Marketing: Data-driven acquisition funnels, conversion rate optimization, and digital campaign infrastructure.
